author: v7_money

baseline.note: Copied the current integration working-tree run.mjs, including existing uncommitted round7 changes; not the HEAD blob.

behavior.case: Reject ASCII case variants after resolve/basename, including default macOS case-insensitive aliases.
behavior.placement: Before backend preflight, input file reads, experiment-lock acquisition and every mkdir/artifact write.
behavior.other_control_directory: .experiment.lock lives outside results and remains excluded by the unchanged direct-child path rule.
behavior.scope: No blanket dot-directory ban; unrelated neighbouring names remain usable. No automatic cleanup or repair of an existing control lock.

coverage: Exact reserved basename, uppercase/mixed case, canonical parent traversal and trailing slash.
Reject before missing backend credentials or input reads, without creating result root or experiment lock.
Existing budget lock and unrelated old attempt bytes remain unchanged.
After rejection, ordinary rules completes; the synthetic DeepSeek executable starts and fails with code 7, preserving the failure and its cost reservation. Retry cannot overwrite it.
Unrelated hidden diagnostic and .deepseek-budget.locked are accepted and append-only.
Experiment-root control lock cannot be named as an output path and is preserved.
provenance: Original logs are from local native CLI tests with three newly synthesized source objects, never original inputs or labels.

Fixture imports/copies current source code and public policy receipts only. It never executes the actual model worker: a local executable answers the Python readiness probe, writes a sentinel and exits 7.

The initial shell wrapper attempted to save the test exit code in zsh read-only status after the red log had been fully written; this emitted a separate wrapper error. The preserved native test log itself records the genuine 3-pass/8-fail baseline, with run.mjs still byte-identical to its snapshot. The green wrapper used run_exit.
The baseline root working tree had unrelated ongoing changes, retained without modification. This author writes only own run.mjs, the new test and newly created round8 evidence.
limits: Local synthetic runner checks only, not real model/API, training, HTTP, full freeze publication or production deployment.
Only observed control names are reserved. New future result-root control paths must be added to the same path policy.
Existing malicious/interrupted budget locks are not removed; manual reconciliation remains required.
Parent owns full integrated checks, independent review, freeze changes, version binding and any commit/push.
